messages:
maria: Quick q — bringing up the 4-bit quant candidate for hosted. What do we want as the hard gates for eval-harness vs human pass? I'm leaning: fail if safety regressions > 0.5% absolute, or benchmark metric drop > 2% with p<0.05. Otherwise allow canary. Also need guidance on seeds / sample sizes. @ajit @sam

ajit: For stats: run 3-5 different seeds, bootstrap CI, and use paired tests where possible. 2k eval samples is a decent baseline for common benchmarks, but for safety subsets we should keep at least 5k if feasible.

sam: We can add a quick harness job in CI — I can wire up a job that runs: `python eval_harness/run.py --model candidate --seeds 0 1 2 --samples 2000` and outputs delta table + p-values. Want me to add thresholds as asserts? :+1:

olivia: Need to be explicit on product impact: e.g., what does 2% drop mean for completion quality / retention? If we allow canary with small regressions we should restrict to non-critical routes.

kai: Also add perf gates — quant can regress tail latency for some kernels. Quick checks: p99 latency under 150ms for 8k context on our canary infra, and no >10% increase in GPU memory due to packing changes.

maria: Proposed onboarding checklist (short):
- run eval_harness full sweep (3 seeds, 2k samples) -> produce metric deltas + p-values
- run dedicated safety suite (5k samples) -> fail on any new safety violations above 0.5%
- perf smoke: p50/p95/p99 + memory check on canary infra
- human spot-check: 200 prompt pairs A/B blind for edge cases
- rollout policy: canary 1% traffic + monitor regressions for 24h, auto-rollback on safety or >3% metric drop
Anyone object or want different thresholds?

ajit: Looks good. For human spot-check use stratified sampling across prompt buckets (instructions, code, multi-turn). Use `eval_harness/analysis/ab_test.py` to randomize pairs.

sam: I'll add these fields to the intake form and attach the CI job. Also will include a small script to format the delta table for engineers. PR incoming.

deploy-bot: Started canary run on cluster-canary-7 for model candidate-2026q1 (no traffic yet)

maria: Perfect — thanks all. I'll draft a one-pager with the thresholds and link it from the model intake. :wave:
